summary: Set 013 (006's P5) Session 1 of 2 COMPLETE. Delivered the two Major exit-code-correctness fixes. Audited siblings (already sanitise) and SwitchboardExporter (fixed file names, no object-name component) -- SaveAsTextExporter was the lone unsanitised Path.Combine.
